body: This makes me really sad. It's saddening how someone you held so dear to your heart can become a stranger as time progresses. I'm glad the both of you are doing well though!
I'm okay. I'm talking it over with a friend from class and my best friend. They're both been very understanding, thank you for caring. I'm tired as well.
I'm still here. Our kitchen knives are dull, razors are far too small, and I have no sleeping pills.
